title.narrative: Outcome 1: Enhanced technical expertise capacities of NNR and CNSS in ageing management, fire hazards and risk informed approach

description.narrative: Enhanced technical expertise capabilities of the nuclear regulatory body in South Africa (NNR) and of its technical support organisation (CNSS) in the field of ageing management, fire hazards and risk informed approach for nuclear installations.

title.narrative: Net Promoter Score (NPS)

description.narrative: Based on KII on training evaluation. The Net Promoter Score (NPS)is a scale from 1 to 10, typically used to inquire about the customer satisfaction. It is a convenient tool for EndUser opinion survey needed to assess the reaction level,or how the participants feel about the training.In this scale 1 means very low/poor satisfaction while 10 means very high satisfaction.

comment.narrative: Net Promoter Score 1 lowest start value
Net Promoter score 8 80 pos. feedback

The NPS of 9 is the average of all technical training topics documented in two survey reports prepared 23 Nov 2023 and 26 Mar 2024 endorsed by the Beneficiary.The currently achieved status for NPS is also recorded in 3rd 6 Monthly Project Progress Report currently under preparation and subject to endorsement by the Beneficairy.

title.narrative: The promotion of an effective nuclear safety culture and implementation of the highest nuclear safety and radiation protection standards

description.narrative: The promotion of an effective nuclear safety culture and implementation of the highest nuclear safety and radiation protection standards

title.narrative: Competence Scoring (KSA*)

description.narrative: Knowledge, Skills, Attitude (KSA) concept is a concept to evaluate the competences of staff. Competences of a staff member are the result of the level of knowledge (know what) , of skills (know why) and of abilities (know why). KSA is promoted by IAEA for human resources in the nuclear industry.

comment.narrative: The effective nuclear safety culture and application of the highest nuclear safety and radiation protection standards is targeted 3 moderate at project end. Measured by KSA.
